mentions.author: asicsp
mentions.story: Ask HN: How to learn Python in 2024?
mentions.text:
There are plenty of free resources:

* Python Programming by University of Helsinki ( [link])

* Harvard CS50's Introduction to Programming with Python ( [course])

* futurecoder ( [link]) — interactive, includes integrated debuggers, enhanced tracebacks, hints for exercises and more

* Think Python ( [link]) — gives you a solid foundation to programming, teaches debugging right the beginning, interesting exercises, etc

* The Python Coding Book ( [link]) — friendly, relaxed programming book for beginners

* PyFlo ( [link]) — interactive beginners guide to becoming a Python programmer

See my resources list [link] for many more links
